prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent foreground terrain sprite for a ToME tabletop dungeon board, stone STAIRS UP, square canvas.
Primary request: a single short freestanding flight of five broad worn limestone steps visibly RISING ABOVE ground, from the bottom/front toward the top/back, ending at an elevated small landing. The two stepped side faces show the height positively and unambiguously. This is a compact architectural miniature, not a character or a UI icon.
Reference role: the previously inspected Kor'Pul floor and production sheet are STYLE/MATERIAL REFERENCES only. Match their muted warm grey-beige weathered stone, chipped pale edges, chunky readable construction and restrained painterly tabletop finish. Do not reproduce their floor, layout or labels.
View: steep overhead orthographic game view, looking down from south, with just enough south/east face visible to read the raised stair height. Stair direction straight north, no diagonal diamond/isometric base. Centered, entire architectural object within the central 82 percent of a square canvas, no part crosses cell edges.
Design for 48px: five large clear treads, strong alternating tread/riser value, broad rising stepped silhouette, small crisp upper-left highlights and dark lower-right contact shadow. Subdued greige stone; bright raised landing, no black recessed well.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background everywhere outside the stairs and a very restrained local contact shadow. NO floor plate or environment; the game supplies the continuous floor underneath. Native alpha is required.
Constraints: one object only, no text, no numbers, no arrow, no border, no round token base, no selection or faction ring, no large red/green/blue areas, no characters, no ornament or rubble clutter, no glow, no frame. No arch or doorway: this sprite is only the raised stone staircase. Make it usable as a clean compositable foreground.
